title: DAY 18/90
WEEK 3 TEST
scenes.sub: Columns to gear trains: one test tonight
scenes.voice: Day eighteen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, ninety one days to go! Week three is done. Tonight we find out what really stuck.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: No new chapter today. It is week three revision: columns and energy methods, three theory of machines topics, and calculus, all in one test.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Revise Euler buckling and Castigliano, mechanism analysis with flywheels, cams and gear trains, and calculus. Rework every question you got wrong this week.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. n links give n into n minus one by two instantaneous centres. A four bar chain has six. Find the hidden ones with Kennedy's three centres theorem.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free week three practice set with full solutions is on Telegram now. Tonight's weekly test, twenty questions, runs seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.
